# HtmlViewGo

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HtmlViewGo:Void htmlview:Int32, URL:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `htmlview` | In | Int32 | required | The handle from [CreateHtmlView](CreateHtmlView). |
| `URL` | In | String | required | The address to go to. |

## Description

Sends the gadget to an address. The gadget then gives a gadget event with the event data 0, which tells that the page has loaded. Going to an address drops the pages that were forward of the current one.
